settings.displayName: Preserve all players’ state during restore
settings.description: Keep selected NBT fields for all players during ordinary restore. A remote true/false overrides this default. Advancements and statistics still restore; players absent from the backup retain their full current NBT.

localizedDisplayName.en-US: Preserve all players’ state during restore
localizedDisplayName.zh-CN: 还原时保留所有玩家状态

localizedDescription.en-US: Keep selected NBT fields for all players during ordinary restore. A remote true/false overrides this default. Advancements and statistics still restore; players absent from the backup retain their full current NBT.
localizedDescription.zh-CN: 普通还原时保留所有玩家的位置、背包、经验等选定 NBT 字段。远程 true/false 可覆盖本次设置；进度和统计仍回档，备份中不存在的玩家保留完整当前 NBT。
